# drop2beets

This mod adds drop2beets to beets, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `beets` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:beets-drop2beets
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:beets-drop2beets|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/beets-drop2beets/
